# TSMP Codec RGB16 0.0.3-beta.3

Beta GPU decoding improvements for TSMP Core 0.3.0-beta.2.

## Changes

- Cache refinement channel candidates instead of repeatedly sampling the same values for candidate combinations.
- Reuse decoded variable-bit symbols across the four output bytes when the total symbol size is at least eight bits.
- Use a Float32 calibration LUT for multisample direct decoding, including variable channel bits. Retain the original single-sample and Refine paths because the additional preparation pass regressed those measured workloads.
- Include the calibration preparation material on the codec prefab. Missing preparation resources fall back to ordinary decoding, but still require the matching Core API.
- Preserve codec IDs, packet layout and existing script/material/prefab GUIDs.

The existing quantization collisions for eight-bit channels and the legacy round-trip limitations below eight total bits are unchanged; baseline equivalence is not a claim that these configurations are lossless.

## Updating

- Update **TSMP Core to 0.3.0-beta.2** before installing this codec.
- UPM declares Core `0.3.0-beta.2`; VPM accepts `>=0.3.0-beta.2`. Core 0.2.0 and 0.3.0-beta.1 lack the preparation API and cannot compile these sources.
- In VCC, enable prerelease packages in the repository at https://vpm.kiba.red/ and select the matching versions.
- Ordinary Unity uses UPM without requiring VRCSDK. Supply Core explicitly through the project manifest for disk or Git installations; a numeric package dependency does not tell UPM to fetch Core from GitHub.
- Install the default Luma4 codec as well, then select this codec in Core's TSMPSetup. Allow Unity and UdonSharp to recompile after updating.

## Validation

On 2026-09-18, the minimum SDK-free package combination was rechecked against released Core 0.3.0-beta.2: prefab/material/shader references, header/payload bytes, sample sizes 1/4 and preparation fallback passed in Unity 2022.3.22f1. Evidence is under `Validation-Results/codec-releases-20260918/preflight/Minimum-RGB16` on the validation machine.

The preparation implementation was checked using Unity 2022.3.22f1, Direct3D11 and an RTX 4090. Recorded candidate-package checks cover the minimum package combinations, shader/material/prefab references, 4/56/1027-byte payloads, sample sizes 1/4, and missing preparation material fallback. The full-set checks cover 27 actual Decoder frames, a Windows x64 Development Mono Player, full UdonSharp client compilation and compiled codec execution in the Udon VM.

[Candidate validation evidence](https://github.com/kibalab/TSMP-Core/blob/v0.3.0-beta.2/Validation~/PackageCompatibility/RESULTS.md) records the tested source versions and limits. Public download/install checks are tracked in the package dependency issue; archive publishing alone is not a runtime test.

These measurements do not establish the same performance on other GPUs or APIs. Live VRChat client execution, Quest, IL2CPP and managed stripping are not verified. Codec optimization does not fix unrelated transport, frame-ordering or Core Linear loopback limitations.
